drafter.private_reasoning: No settlement amount or authority to offer a specific figure was provided. Leave the amount for client and partner approval rather than inventing one. Propose a payment deadline, a dispute-specific release, and customary confidentiality exceptions. Do not disclose privileged advice.
drafter.message_to_opposing_counsel: Thank you. We have revised the draft to provide a payment deadline, limit the release to claims arising from the dispute, and add customary confidentiality exceptions. The Settlement Amount remains subject to our client’s approval; we will provide a figure as soon as we have authority to do so. Please let us know if you have comments on the revised release and exceptions in the meantime.

edits.text: 1. PAYMENT. Defendant shall pay Plaintiff a Settlement Amount of $[AMOUNT—SUBJECT TO CLIENT APPROVAL] within 30 calendar days after both parties sign this Agreement, by a payment method designated in writing by Plaintiff.
edits.name: Payment terms

edits.text: 2. RELEASE. Upon receipt of the Settlement Amount in full, Plaintiff releases Defendant from claims, whether known or unknown, arising out of the matters described in the pleadings in this dispute through the date both parties sign this Agreement. This release does not cover obligations under this Agreement or claims arising after that date.
edits.name: Scope of release

edits.text: 3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except that either party may disclose them to its attorneys, tax advisers, accountants, insurers, and financial advisers who have a need to know and are informed of their confidential nature; as required by law, court order, or applicable reporting obligations; or as necessary to enforce this Agreement. Where legally permitted and reasonably practicable, a party required to disclose the terms shall give the other party prompt notice.
edits.name: Confidentiality exceptions

partner.private_reasoning: The rendered agreement and cover note do not disclose the client's privileged information. The payment amount is expressly subject to client approval, and no hidden-content categories are identified for removal.

We also propose that any dismissal occur only after Plaintiff receives cleared funds, with interest accruing on any payment made after the 30-day deadline.
